title: CLI Version 2.1.0
description:
Bug Fixes:

  • @contentstack/cli-cm-import (2.0.1):
    • Clarified the global field reference-field warning message shown when importing a global field.
  • @contentstack/cli-bulk-operations (2.1.0):
    • Fixed an issue where assets were being published to all environments instead of only the scoped targets.
  • @contentstack/cli-cm-bootstrap (2.0.1):
    • Fixed bootstrap failing silently on non-2xx tarball responses, hidden spinner errors, and imprecise branch-not-found error messages.
  • contentstack-cli-tsgen (5.1.0):
    • Fixed the tsgen GraphQL type-generation command failing with a generic schema error instead of surfacing the real underlying error.
  • types-generator (3.10.5):
    • Fixed the tsgen GraphQL type-generation command failing with a generic schema error instead of surfacing the real underlying error.
